root_cause: The writer was not constrained to Slack's mrkdwn dialect, and source notifications used generic Backlog evidence/actions even for PR-ready items. CI check results and the PR URL were discarded, and delivered source messages did not refresh when evidence changed.
fix_summary: Normalize model-generated bold/bullets for Slack, request native formatting, preserve PR URLs and GitHub check evidence, use state-specific next actions, and edit an existing notification when source evidence changes rather than posting duplicates. Live repair evidence is recorded in STATE.md.
